title: Deep Native-Content Fidelity

imageFidelity.specialistInspection: MuPDF trace device plus image mask metadata
imageFidelity.shared: instance-local reconstruction; shared source resource is not mutated
validation: attached soft mask survives source transform
nested Form child images remain selectable but mutation-protected in favor of instance-level Form editing

vectorFidelity.appearanceOverride: simple un-clipped Normal-blend RGB/Gray/CMYK/BGR state only
vectorFidelity.shadingAndPatternOperators: detected/warned; no false claim of editable shading or pattern objects

tableFidelity.supported: explicit rectangular full-grid cell coverage without embedded images/non-grid artwork

acceptance: Every promoted object class has deterministic capability rules and a fail-closed unsupported state.

Plain/shared images support instance-local edits; attached-soft-mask images support source transform/delete only; explicit masks, clipping, non-Normal blending and ambiguous image state remain protected.
Qualified vector geometry edits preserve inherited graphics state, while unsafe appearance overrides and clip-defining paths are blocked.
Qualified nonuniform and rectangular merged/irregular tables preserve explicit full-grid cell geometry; ambiguous or embedded complex content is blocked.
Cross-region paragraph reflow is limited to a uniquely detected two-region thread with deterministic blocker, width and page-boundary rules.
Every native export still passes the existing P8 source/output fidelity gate before publication.
P17 adds no network dependency, executable-version cut, or project/database/native-editor schema migration.
